name: Angelic Souls Inc.
source:
An angel wants to interview you. What will your answers to their questions be? Where do your values lie? How much respect do you have for Hatsune Miku?

[From [url=https://teletuu.itch.io/angelic-souls-inc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位天使想采访你。你对他们的问题的答案是什么？你的价值观在哪里？你对初音未来有多少尊重？

[来自[url=https://teletuu.itch.io/angelic-souls-inc]itch.io[/url]]
